title: The affirmation layer is very important, but too difficult, so we never get there (2026-11-06)

sections.content:
Lets look at the general state of our affirmation process. 
I need to get the agent editor working group set up clearnly. I need tensions affirmed properly. 

The affirmation layer is very important. But it's also too difficult and so we never get there. We have the method editor and the control room.
